text:
sarah: paging oncall — sudden spike on embeddings route (/v1/embeddings) in eu-west-1, tail latency and 429s for multiple tenants :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Alert: High error rate detected on service=runtime route=/v1/embeddings region=eu-west-1 threshold=5m
ops-bot: Auto-mitigation suggestions: 1) per-endpoint quota decrease 2) route-based rate-limit 3) divert low-priority traffic to fallback model. See /runbooks/embeddings-throttles (links internal)
jin: agree we should do route-specific throttle first, lowering embeddings rps to 20 for non-dedicated customers. Can someone run the API call?
carol: I'm on it, applying temporary quota for route /v1/embeddings for tier=free+pro as 20rps -- will run a canary on a small subset then roll.
carol: executing: ```curl -X POST https://admin.internal/api/quota/update -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","scope":"non-dedicated","rps":20,"reason":"live-mitigation spike eu-west-1"}'```
ops-bot: Quota update accepted, change id=chg_2026-03-17_01. Canaries active on 2% of traffic.
jin: canary metrics look good after 30s — error rate down from 12% to 1.8%, p95 latency from 980ms -> 240ms.
sarah: nice. Next, reduce parallel KV cache TTL for embeddings to 30s for same scope to reduce load (non-invasive). I'll push that.
sarah: pushed cache TTL change, id=cfg_7782.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0317-embeds-spike, severity=high, lead=@sarah. Pager escalations paused after mitigation.
emma-cs: FYI CS — we have three paying customers who saw 429s. Requesting brief email status and ETA to full resolution.
mike: I'll take over oncall for night shift. Handoff: mitigations in place (rps 20 for non-dedicated, cache TTL=30s), monitoring set, alert threshold lowered for next 2 hours. Runbook link: https://redwood.company/runbooks/embeds-throttle.
sarah: handoff ack to @mike. Next steps: 1) monitor 30m, 2) prepare rollback plan if latency resurges, 3) follow up with model-team to see if quantization or batching config can be tuned tomorrow.
emma-cs: I'll draft customer note and sync with product for messaging.
mike: taking it. I'll open a post-incident doc if we stay stable. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
